'''Ruku Myal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Saber]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. A good friend of [[Gavar Khai]], Myal participated in an [[Skirmish near Eriadu|attack]] on a [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian]] [[S18 light freighter]] circa [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]].

Having achieved the rank of [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], Myal was later among the surviving Sith sided with [[Abeloth]]. In [[44 ABY]] when [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] starts to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|infiltrate]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he posed as [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of [[Galactic Alliance Security]] and was in command of a patrol of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. On [[Hovertrain/Legends|levtrain]] station he recognized among infiltrators former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] with [[Ben Skywalker]]. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], took his attention from Khai by damaging overhead [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of [[BAMR News]] Sith infiltrator reporter [[Kayala Fei]]. Myal was about to attack Luke Skywalker when he was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Pull|pulled]] towards him in [[Force jump/Legends|midjump]]. Myal activated his [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] inadvertanly taking attention to himself as a Jedi, who were only known to have lightsabers that time, and attacked Skywalker trying to [[Sai cha/Legends|behead]] him. Skywalker weaponless avoided Myal's attack. Khai then used Myal's distraction and with Myal's own [[shikkar]] she stabbed him close to his heart for painfull [[Death/Legends|death]]. Luke Skywalker then [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|slightly shifted]] shards of snapped shikkar blade into Myal's heart, killing him instantly.
